review_notes: I read the whole file. I also grepped the NavierStokesAndEuler directory for uses of adjugate, cofactorValue, cofactorBilinear, rowOperator and crossOperator_apply. The existing simp lemmas (basis_norm, rowOperator_apply, cofactorBilinear_apply) are oriented sensibly and I found no loops or competing rules. The one gap is that the cofactor and adjugate chain stops at the plain defs `cofactorValue` and `adjugate`, which have no simp-normal-form lemma. I did not run Lean, so the proposed lemmas are untested. Whether `simp` can fully replace the `change` calls downstream is uncertain.

findings.excerpt: def adjugate (A : EndSpace) : EndSpace := cofactorBilinear A A
findings.problem: The simp set stops half-way through the cofactor chain. `cofactorBilinear_apply` is @[simp] and rewrites `cofactorBilinear A B` to `cofactorValue A B`. But `adjugate A` has no simp lemma connecting it to `cofactorBilinear A A` or `cofactorValue A A`. `cofactorValue A B` also has no applied or unfolding lemma. As a result `simp` leaves `adjugate A` opaque and cannot reach the already-simp `cofactorBilinear_apply` or `rowOperator_apply`. The file has to unfold the definition by hand, either with `change ‖cofactorValue A A‖ ≤ ...` in `adjugate_norm` or by listing `adjugate` and `cofactorValue` inside a long `simp only` in `operatorMatrix_adjugate`. Downstream code in PacketParentCoefficientBounds does the same with `change ... adjugate (F x) v`.
findings.proposed_change: Add a simp lemma `adjugate_eq (A : EndSpace) : adjugate A = cofactorValue A A := rfl`, or an applied form `adjugate_apply (A v)`. The orientation toward `cofactorValue` matches the existing `cofactorBilinear_apply`, so the rules cannot cycle. Optionally add `cofactorValue_apply (A B v)`, which expands to the three `rowOperator` terms. `adjugate_norm` and the `simp only` list in `operatorMatrix_adjugate` could then use this lemma instead of `change` and manual unfolding. Do not mark `cofactorValue` itself @[simp] for unfolding, since that would expand it everywhere.
findings.benefit: `adjugate A` would simplify to the same normal form as `cofactorBilinear A A`, and one named rewrite would replace the `change` unfoldings and ad-hoc `simp only [adjugate, ...]` lists in this file and in PacketParentCoefficientBounds. The normal form stays `cofactorValue A A`, so `cofactorValue` itself is not unfolded.

evidence.excerpt: @[simp] theorem cofactorBilinear_apply (A B : EndSpace) : cofactorBilinear A B = cofactorValue A B
change M x v = F₁ x (adjugate (F x) v)
